sense: of soldiers, war or the armed forces

terms.comment: rēs mīlitāris, warfare, the art of war.

evidence: Traupman 187: in peace and in war, on the home front and the front line, domī et mīlitiae
terms.comment: domī mīlitiaeque, at home and in the field.

phrases.latin: multī saepe mīlitārī sagulō opertum humī jacentem inter custōdiās statiōnēsque mīlitum cōnspexērunt
phrases.english: many often saw him lying on the ground, wrapped in a soldier’s cloak, among the sentries and the pickets
whom they called by a soldiers’ nickname, Caligula

sources: Lewis & Short: militaris · Lewis & Short: bellicus · Lewis & Short: militia
